`src/Encina.OpenTelemetry/MessagingStores/InstrumentedSagaStore.cs:49,59,69,87,104` (`result.IfLeft(err => Failed(activity, err.Message));`) and `:192-195` (`private static void Failed(Activity? activity, string? errorMessage) => activity?.SetStatus(ActivityStatusCode.Error, errorMessage);`): `EncinaError.Message` is written directly into the OpenTelemetry `Activity` status description on every failed saga-store operation. Fails AGENTS.md paragraph "`EncinaError.Message` NEVER reaches logs, activity tags, health-check results or plaintext storage; record only the error code or the exception type" (why: #1168, #1173, #1259, #1274).
